title: Wiggle Worms Kits Alternatives: 5 Preschool Boxes - Cratejoy
summary: Compare five preschool craft boxes like Wiggle Worms Kits for ages 3 to 5 by activities, price, and delivery, from the closest match to a box for two kids.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


What is the closest alternative to Wiggle Worms Kits?


Little Dreamers Club is the closest: a monthly themed box for ages 3 to 5 with 6 to 8 crafts, a storybook, and all the supplies, at about $38 a month with free US shipping. For a younger child or more learning activities, Curiosity Box Kids’ Discover Box for ages 2 to 4 comes next.


Which of these boxes costs the least?


KiwiCo Koala Crate is about $30 a crate at its regular price, and Curiosity Box Kids is $34 a month. Curiosity Box Kids, Green Kid Crafts, and We Craft Box also cost less per box on a 3-, 6-, or 12-month prepay.


Can I send one of these as a gift?


Yes. Each Cratejoy listing here has a Give as a Gift option and prepaid plans of 3, 6, or 12 months. The listing shows an estimated ship date before you buy.


What can my child move to after age 5?


Little Dreamers Club has a box for ages 6 to 8, Curiosity Box Kids moves up to its Creation Station Box for ages 5 to 7, Green Kid Crafts’ Discovery Box runs from 5 to 10 and up, and We Craft Box is made for ages 3 to 9. For kids who like to build, see our[KiwiCo alternatives](https://www.cratejoy.com/blogs/box-insider/kiwico-alternatives) .
